title: Rabbi's office
description: By appointment via the secretary: religious questions, Jewish wedding, divorce, circumcision, burial, confirmation of Jewish descent, conversion.

title: Kosher canteen
description: Jewish and familiar European dishes. Meals for tourist groups can be arranged.

title: "New Synagogue" Museum
description: Permanent exhibition on the history and culture of Jewish Königsberg. Opened on 18 September 2022, on the 2nd floor of the building.

title: Excursion office
description: The synagogue can be visited every day except Saturday as part of a guided tour. Private tours — call the excursion office.

title: Mikvah
description: The community has men's and women's mikvahs. Ask the community how to book.
hours: [ВПИШИ: часы и порядок записи в микву]
